question: A man covers equal distances at the speed of 19 km/hr, 8 km/hr and 5km/hr. His average speed for the entire journey is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 3 equal distances covered at speeds x, y, and z, Average Speed = (3xyz) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Here, the given speeds are x = 19, y = 8, z = 5.

Average Speed = (3 × 19 × 8 × 5) ÷ (19×8 + 8×5 + 5×19)

Average Speed = 2280 ÷ (152 + 40 + 95) = 2280 ÷ 287

Average Speed = 7 ²⁷¹/₂₈₇ km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 7 ²⁷¹/₂₈₇ km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Speeds for three equal distances: S₁ = 19 km/hr, S₂ = 8 km/hr, S₃ = 5 km/hr.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 
 
 

 Distance = d
 Distance = d
 Distance = d

 Speed: 19 km/hr
 Speed: 8 km/hr
 Speed: 5 km/hr

 Time = d/19
 Time = d/8
 Time = d/5

 Total Distance = 3d
 Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the equal distance covered in each part be d km.

⇒ Total Distance = d + d + d = 3d km.

⇒ Total Time = (d/19) + (d/8) + (d/5)

⇒ Taking LCM of 19, 8, and 5 which gives 760.

⇒ Total Time = d × [(40 + 95 + 152) ÷ 760]

⇒ Total Time = d × (287 ÷ 760)

⇒ Average Speed = 3d ÷ [d × (287 ÷ 760)]

⇒ Average Speed = (3 × 760) ÷ 287

⇒ Average Speed = 2280 ÷ 287 = 7 ²⁷¹/₂₈₇ km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 ²⁷¹/₂₈₇ km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

When a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is directly given by (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Unequal Distances

If distinct distances d₁, d₂, d₃... are covered at individual speeds s₁, s₂, s₃..., then Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂ + d₃...) ÷ (t₁ + t₂ + t₃...).

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the exact same direction, relative speed = |s₁ − s₂|. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = s₁ + s₂.
